title: BIBLIOGRAPHY OF EARLY MODERN EDITIONS OF PIERRE DE PROVENCE ET LA BELLE MAGUELONNE (CA. 1470–CA. 1800)
descriptions: This dataset provides bibliographic information on 239 early modern editions of the story of Pierre de Provence et la belle Maguelonne, printed in 15 different languages between ca. 1470 and ca. 1800. It consists of 1. a PDF version comprising the data and metadata, including footnotes and a bibliography, and 2. an Excel sheet with only the data. The data sheets have been compiled in the context of a chapter on the early modern reception of the medieval romance of Pierre de Provence et la belle Maguelonne in Rita Schlusemann, Helwi Blom, Anna Katharina Richter and Krystyna Wierzbicka-Trwoga (eds.), Top Ten Fictional Narratives in Early Modern Europe; Translation, Dissemination and Mediality (Berlin: De Gruyter, 2023), pp. 225–258. https://doi.org/10.1515/9783110764451-008
